machine: the author's Windows 11 workstation; WARP (Microsoft Basic Render Driver) through RAW_NATIVE_D3D12_WARP=1 on every D3D12 command, software only. The GPU was held by MMBU training and not taken; nvidia-smi sampled every 20 s during every WARP run never listed raw_native_cli. Builds and runs at Idle priority with at most 4 build jobs.
order: Bounds committed first (11c3a96), Addendum A after the first fixture export and before any build or run (f8d2159), then code, first CPU run, first WARP run, diagnosis and a WGSL fix, WARP rerun, the C++ source edit, the WGSL source edit, revert.

first_cpu_run.note: The C++ equals the JavaScript on every image value (f32) and code of all fifteen cases, the advected-canvas layer state included. The bounds allowed last-bit differences in exp, log, pow, tanh, sinh and cosh; none reached a stored value.

first_warp_run.diagnosis: The differences sat in one channel of saturated colours. Running the C++ compose on the GPU's own Kuwahara, stroke and relief buffers matched the CPU (max 1 code), so the fault was inside the GPU compose. A dump of pixel (138, 7) of the bars frame showed the GPU glaze's blue channel at +0.00804 against the CPU's -0.000509; a numpy f32 emulation of the same glaze gives -0.000509, so f32 arithmetic was not the cause. WARP's sinh and cosh were off by about 1e-4 relative near z = 13. Yellow's blue channel is a near cancellation of the colour-matching weights, and its glaze ratio divides by a 1e-4 floor, so the error was magnified about 1e4 and clamped to the other end of [0.5, 2].
first_warp_run.fix: WGSL only: sinh and cosh built from one exp in the glaze, with b = sqrt(ks (2 + ks)) and a series for small z (forms equal to the reference's). The C++ and JavaScript references are unchanged.

cpp.against_prediction: Held: every case failed (still and motion image max_abs 0.005 to 0.097; 776 to 454,632 codes differ).

wgsl.against_prediction: Held for the stills it predicted: the four impasto cases failed (max 14 to 50 codes, mean 1.5 to 3.2) and the two watercolour cases passed (max 1). The motion and post-frame cases, not predicted, split the same way by medium.
